description: This file contains build definitions and device configurations for the OpenWRT project targeting various routers and hardware devices. It defines build procedures, device-specific parameters, and package assignments, primarily in the form of makefile macros and variable assignments.

methods.name: Build/asus-fake-ramdisk
methods.description: Creates a fake ramdisk image by zeroing out a block and logging the kernel initramfs value.

methods.name: Build/asus-fake-rootfs
methods.description: Builds a fake root filesystem image with specified content, compressed with squashfs.

methods.name: Build/asus-trx
methods.description: Creates a TRX firmware image using an external tool and moves it to overwrite existing file.

methods.name: Build/wax6xx-netgear-tar
methods.description: Packages Netgear device images into a tarball, computes md5, and writes metadata.

methods.name: Build/zyxel-nwa210ax-fit
methods.description: Generates Zyxel device fit image with specific shell script and mkimage tool.
